svg.title: Marcos Stipicich: Supply Chain & Operations × Deployment Strategist (Giant Doctrine Fan & Pre-Cutover Vaccines)
svg.desc: Full-width semicircular doctrine fan mapping six operational failure seams to coined deployment doctrine, checkable proof, and four pre-cutover adversarial vaccines.
svg.text: 50,000+ SKU Cutover (-20%) · USD 30M P&L (~USD 5M Freed) · The Deployment Chasm (551 pp.) · 10,756 Passing Tests
Operational red-teaming & friction reduction before go-live
Make the compliant workflow faster than the shortcut;
guard only costly writes, reason logged before saving.
Red-team bonuses, quotas & exception paths from a
rushed shift's lens before parallel spreadsheets appear.
checks & extract probes (1:N joins, 103/105/124) fail closed.
Gate indirect inputs; zero-LLM financial math; stage
every ERP write in DRAFT (HMAC-SHA256, 900s TTL) + rollback.
